jyutping: m4 do1 tung4 jan4 loi4 wong5

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for someone who keeps to themselves and prefers little social contact.

examples.english: They are reclusive and would rather stay home reading on their days off.
examples.traditional: 佢唔多同人來往，放假寧願留喺屋企睇書。
